name: UNF
title: Start with the booking worksheet
rule: Identify the key and repeating extras. Omit calculated totals.
dependencies: BookingID identifies the worksheet. Each booking can contain several extras; braces mark the repeating group.
note: This is a teaching projection of the booking screen, not an additional database table. Customer and location names here mean current master data; historical snapshots are discussed separately.

name: 1NF
title: Remove repeating attributes
rule: Move extras into their own relation and copy BookingID into its compound key.
dependencies: (BookingID, ExtraID) → Quantity, UnitPrice. ExtraID → ExtraName is still a partial dependency.
note: Each cell now holds one value. One extra occurs at most once per booking; Quantity represents multiple units. Bookings with no extras remain in BookingHeader.

name: 2NF
title: Remove partial key dependencies
rule: Move ExtraName, which depends only on ExtraID, into RentalExtra.
note: The agreed UnitPrice stays with the booking-extra pair: the same extra may have a different price on another booking. BookingHeader has a single-column key and already meets 2NF for this projection.

name: 3NF
title: Remove transitive dependencies
rule: Separate customer and location facts from the booking header.
dependencies: BookingID → CustomerID → CustomerName; BookingID → PickupBranchID → CityID → ProvinceID. Move each descriptive fact to the entity that determines it.
note: The live schema also has return_branch_id, uses first_name and last_name, and gives BookingExtra a surrogate primary key plus UNIQUE(booking_id, extra_id). Historical snapshots and calculated totals are implementation choices, not part of this strict 3NF projection.
